title: Late-Charge Record and Reductions of the Early-Termination Charge — Contingency Placement Agreements
content:
**Standard.** Where reductions apply to the early-termination charge on an agreement under the Contingency Placement Agreements, they are first added into one reduction share, and that share is then multiplied by a goodwill share set by the late charges booked on the agreement in the 12 months before the handling date: none of the reduction share is kept where 3 or more late charges were booked, half of it (50 percent) is kept where 1 or 2 were booked, and all of it is kept where none was booked. The charge after proration is reduced once by the resulting share; the reductions do not act one after another.

**The 12 months.** A window of a number of months before a date covers the dates after the same day that number of months earlier, up to and including that date. A late charge counts when it is booked on the agreement — a late-charge entry in the agreement's client money history — with a date in the window ending on the handling date.

## Decision table

| Late charges booked on the agreement in the 12 months before the handling date | Goodwill share | Share of the reduction kept |
|---|---|---|
| 3 or more | 0 | none |
| 1 or 2 | 0.5 | half |
| none | 1 | all |

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

Inputs: a charge after proration of 6250.00 USD and an added reduction share of 0.25.

| Late charges in the window | Resulting share | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| none | 0.25 multiplied by 1, which is 0.25 | 6250.00 USD less 25 percent of it: 4687.50 USD |
| 2 | 0.25 multiplied by 0.5, which is 0.125 | 6250.00 USD less 12.5 percent of it: 5468.75 USD |
| 3 | 0.25 multiplied by 0, which is 0 | 6250.00 USD |

The share acts once on the charge after proration: a reduction share of 0.25 made of two parts of 0.15 and 0.10 reduces 6250.00 USD by 0.25 in one step, giving 4687.50 USD where all of it is kept.
